english.title: Sell / offer to sell / arrange to sell right to observe / participate in a low-welfare animal activity abroad
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in England,

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[offered or arranged to sell]_

a right to

(C)_[observe]_
(D)_[participate in]_

an activity taking place outside the UK which involved an animal and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 1(1) and 3(1) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) "Offering" to sell includes making an invitation to treat (section 6 of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023).
(ii) See section 3(6) of the Act for offences committed by bodies corporate.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, in England,

(A)_[sold]_
(B)_[offered or arranged to sell]_

a right to

(C)_[observe]_
(D)_[participate in]_

an activity which involved an animal, took place outside the United Kingdom and was of a description specified by activity regulations made by the Secretary of State, namely **(..SPECIFY ACTIVITY..).

other.penalty:
Summary: a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None - see section 3(6) of the Animals (Low-Welfare Activities Abroad) Act 2023.
